newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Dec 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Monday:
- The Microsoft Corp plans to increase spending on basic research by 300 percent in 1997.
- Senate GOP Leader Trent Lott says the Federal Reserve Board should lower interest rates to stimulate growth.
- The Canadian Auto Workers union has reached agreement with Canadian Airlines and the government on a recovery plan that includes employee pay cuts.

- One of the hottest technologies in the computer industry is "push" or "webcasting" software, which delivers news, stock quotes and other information from the Internet directly to personal computers.

- Narrative Communications, a start-up company, is shipping software that permits the distribution and viewing of feature-length, interactive multi-media over the Internet using ordinary telephone lines.
- Foreign language film has hit hard times in the U.S. since its heyday 30 years ago.
- As cable television continues adding channels with 24-hour schedules, the market for old network television shows has never been hotter.
